code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild microcytic anemia, elevated ferritin, and increased INR. There is also mild hypoalbuminemia, low total protein, and mild elevation of monocytes and basophils. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired oxygenation. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are strongly recommended.
